name: agent-observability
description: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and debugging infrastructure for AI agent workflows to ensure visibility, diagnose issues quickly, and optimize performance.

inputs.name: agent_workflow
inputs.description: Complete agent workflow design including tasks, handoffs, and dependencies
inputs.format: Workflow diagram, task definitions, handoff specifications

inputs.name: monitoring_requirements
inputs.format: Requirements document with metrics, SLOs, compliance needs

inputs.name: infrastructure_constraints
inputs.format: List of available tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus)

inputs.name: performance_targets
inputs.description: Target metrics for latency, throughput, error rates
inputs.format: Quantitative targets (e.g., p95 latency < 2s, error rate < 1%)

inputs.name: budget_constraints
inputs.format: Monthly budget for logging, metrics, tracing

outputs.name: observability_plan
outputs.description: Comprehensive plan for logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting
outputs.format: Document with architecture, tool selection, implementation steps

outputs.name: logging_configuration
outputs.description: Structured logging setup with log levels, formats, and destinations

outputs.name: metrics_instrumentation
outputs.description: Code and configuration for collecting performance metrics

outputs.name: tracing_setup
outputs.description: Distributed tracing configuration for multi-agent workflows

outputs.name: dashboards
outputs.description: Operational dashboards for monitoring agent health and performance

outputs.name: alerts
outputs.description: Alert rules for proactive notification of issues
outputs.format: Alert definitions with thresholds and notification channels

outputs.name: runbooks
outputs.description: Operational runbooks for common issues and debugging procedures
